answers.purpose: Close the findings of an editorial review: grade every finding into one closing move against the calibrated rubric, score the run, build the closing plan, spot-check the batch with the user, and apply the removals, corrections and rewordings to the pages as an uncommitted diff.

triggers.disambiguation: Not /init (CLAUDE.md scaffolding). Not editorial (writes and reviews prose) nor editorial-review (produces findings). This skill consumes review findings, decides one closing move for each, and applies the mechanical moves to the pages without committing.
